profile.summary: fralonra is a Mid-Level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in the Fastify ecosystem. Their contributions focus on improving Fastify's documentation, plugin ecosystem, and TypeScript integration. With 37 PRs exclusively in the Fastify repository, they demonstrate deep knowledge of Fastify's internals (hooks, logging, error handling) and a strong ability to maintain high-quality technical documentation. While their contributions are primarily backend-focused, their work reflects proficiency in Node.js patterns, modular design, and plugin development. No frontend or testing experience is visible in their PR history.
